svg.title: How one TrialRun review moves
svg.desc: A GitHub pull request enters TrialRun's persistent Zerops control plane. One exact Codex connection is selected for the job. The runner creates an isolated Zerops project for the base and pull request applications, records browser evidence, publishes the result to GitHub, and deletes that exact temporary project.
svg.text: One selected Codex connection → one isolated review project → recorded proof → exact teardown.

g.text: one private Codex home per customer
Disposable Zerops project for one review
private network; base and PR state stay separate
checks the run plan and exact SHAs
the model never holds Zerops or GitHub credentials
deleted in finally; absence is checked

svg.text: Exactly one Codex connection is pinned to each job. Managed runs now; ZCP can replace it per customer.
